title: a11y type/invoke: parent window falsely detected as blocker on elevated dialogs
desc: When a11y type reports blocker persists and aborts, check if the blocker IS the parent of the target. Parent windows are containers, not obstructions. Fix: use --sudo. IsAncestorWindow check fires and skips the abort.
steps: When 'a11y type' aborts with 'blocker persists', verify that the so-called blocker window is actually the parent (ancestor) of the target — parent containers are not real obstructions and should be ignored.
Workaround: re-run the same command with --sudo. The elevated path uses IsAncestorWindow() to detect this case and skips the blocker abort automatically.
Long-term fix: walk the UIA tree and confirm blocker is an ancestor of target before bypassing; never blanket-skip blocker checks for non-ancestor overlays.
author: claude
